svg.title: YOLO26n ROI performance on Ubuntu and RTX 2060
svg.desc: Measured total P50 for no ROI, one full-frame ROI and two local ROIs; paired result-filter increments across five backends. Five warm-ups and fifty measured calls per route.

g.text: 计时含 JPEG 解码、前处理、推理/解码及释放；排除读文件、解析配置、绘图。未锁频；结果适用于本例的区域与候选数量。
